label: A_cF8_227_a-001
title: Diamond ($A4$) Structure
comments:
This is the first crystal structure to be determined by X-ray diffraction. 
 Carbon can also be found in nature as \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hP4_194_bc-001}{graphite ($A9$)}, \href{current_web_home_dir/A_hP4_194_f-001}{lonsdaleite (hexagonal diamond}}, and \href{current_web_home_dir/A_cP240_205_10d-001}{buckminsterfullerene (C$_{60}$)}.
